title: Vintage Ansco Camera Cadet III - 127 Film - Binghamton NY
categoryName: Cameras & Photo:Vintage Movie & Photography:Vintage Cameras:Other Vintage Cameras
descriptionText: The Vintage Ansco Camera Cadet III is a classic piece of photography history made in Binghamton, NY. This gray camera, with the iconic Ansco brand, features the Cadet III model and is a perfect addition to any vintage camera collection. Made in the United States, this camera captures timeless moments with its 127 film capability, making it a must-have for photography enthusiasts looking to add a unique touch to their vintage camera collection.
